descriptionHtml:
Our popular foam prints are sleek, modern, and super lightweight. Perfect to lift the look of any space—foam prints are versatile, available in various sizes, and will last for years to come:

  • Material: Solid PVC panel with UV film for a lightweight, durable, long-lasting print.
  • Texture & Finish: Smooth with an intense, natural look, perfect for any space.
  • Color Options: Available in white or black.
  • Thickness: 5mm (0.2") for a modern finish.
  • Hanging Kit: Included; varies by country.
  • Sizes: 18 options in inches (US&CA) and cms (rest of the world).
